Definition: from G4862 and G3887; to remain in company, i.e. still live:--continue with.
BiblicalUsage: Paul writes with confidence that he will abide and continue with the Philippians for their furtherance and joy of faith. The King James reading carries the little word for together, that his remaining is a remaining with them, though the older Greek copies read simply that he will remain, and either way the point stands: his life is theirs, for their joy in the faith.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that a minister's staying is a gift to the church, and I hold that remaining with God's people for their joy is worth more than going on to something greater.
